summary.text: Gretchen Bulova is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 11, which covers part of Fairfax County and the City of Fairfax.
Gretchen Bulova has been a member since January 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Gretchen Bulova was born in Fort Benning, Georgia, in 1969.
Gretchen Bulova studied at the College of William and Mary (B.A., 1991) and George Washington University (M.A.).
Gretchen Bulova's listed occupation is museum director.

Gretchen Bulova's listed memberships and affiliations include the Fairfax County History Commission, the Fairfax250 Commission, the VA250 Commission, the Virginia Association of Museums, and the American Alliance of Museums.
The profile lists David Bulova as Gretchen Bulova's spouse.
The House profile lists Gretchen Bulova's committee assignments as Finance, Education, and Privileges and Elections.
